annotations.title: FINMA register fuzzy name search (free trial, 20 calls per day)

description: FREE TRIAL without a key: 20 calls per day per IP address in total for tariff_semantic_search, classify_text and finma_search. Each answer states the trial calls left; check every result on the official FINMA register before use. Search the FINMA register by entity name, tolerant of case, accents, legal forms (AG, SA, Sàrl, GmbH, Ltd), ae/oe/ue spellings and one or two typos per word. Results are ranked exact, word start, whole word, prefix, substring, all words in any order, then typo guesses, each labelled with match_type. Set include_warnings=true to also search the FINMA warnings list. Each answer states the FINMA data version.

include_warnings.description: Also search the FINMA warnings list

name.description: Entity name, or a distinctive part of it (typos, accents and legal forms such as AG/SA/Ltd are tolerated)
